title: Local LLM vs Cloud: Which Is Faster on Your Code?
description:
Is your local model really slower than the cloud? Time it yourself. ⏱️

✅ Make one client for local Ollama and one for the cloud
✅ Time the same task in a loop
✅ Run it and compare the seconds
